tasks.label: Extract HTML embedded CSS
args: const fs=require('fs');const hp='c:\\Users\\HomePC\\Downloads\\Rubik CFOP\\3x3 CFOP_ OLL Guide.html';const cp='c:\\Users\\HomePC\\Downloads\\Rubik CFOP\\style.css';let h=fs.readFileSync(hp,'utf8');const m=h.match(/<style>([\s\S]*?)<\\/style>/);if(!m)throw new Error('No embedded style block found');fs.writeFileSync(cp,m[1].trim()+'\n','utf8');h=h.replace(/<style>[\s\S]*?<\\/style>/,'');const needle='  <link href=\"https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;600&family=Inter:wght@400;600;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@600;700&display=swap\" rel=\"stylesheet\">';if(!h.includes(needle))throw new Error('Stylesheet insertion point not found');h=h.replace(needle,needle+'\n  <link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"style.css\">');fs.writeFileSync(hp,h,'utf8');console.log('Extracted CSS and linked style.css')
